values./system/description: Dogmeat's Initiative is the same as yours. His carry weight is 50 lbs. Dogmeat’s level is the same as yours and increases whenever you level up. Increase either Dogmeat’s Body or Mind by +1 when you reach level 3 or any odd numbered level after that. Increase Dogmeat’s HP by +1 per level, and with any increases to Body. Increase Dogmeat’s bite damage by +1CD at 5th level and every 5 levels beyond that.
